resources.string: Touch is off. Swipe back or press Back for the Control Center.

Slow finger movement aims precisely and fast swipes cover more distance. Leave it on unless you prefer the pointer to follow your finger one to one; Trackpad and Local cursor apply it from the next stream.
After a quick flick the pointer keeps moving and slows down; touching the screen stops it at once. Trackpad and Local cursor touch modes.
The part of the screen where Trackpad and Local cursor gestures may start; touches that start elsewhere are ignored. Pick a half to rest a thumb on the other side.
What a quick three-finger tap does. System keyboard is Android’s; PC keyboard has F-keys, Ctrl and Win; Keyboard & mouse is a panel with keys and a trackpad.
Nightjar can’t draw the PC’s cursor shape, so it shows the default arrow.
What a quick four-finger tap does. System keyboard is Android’s; PC keyboard has F-keys, Ctrl and Win; Keyboard & mouse is a panel with keys and a trackpad.
Finger taps cancelled by the system

Three- and four-finger taps that the system cancels, as some Oppo and ColorOS phones do, still run their action when the fingers landed together and stayed still; on Android 13 and newer only cancels the system flags count, on Android 12 and older any cancel in that window does. Turn on only if three- or four-finger taps do nothing when your fingers are close together.
In Multi-touch mode, three- and four-finger taps run their actions and no longer reach the PC as touches. Leave it off if something on the PC uses those taps.
